notablePrerequisites:

description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0} due to Rowan's ability.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
